cross_references.relationship: broader successor — ADA Title II extended Section 504's disability discrimination prohibition from federally funded programs to ALL public entities regardless of funding source
enforcement vehicle — Section 504 violations by state actors under color of law are actionable through §1983
model statute — Section 504 was modeled on Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964; same framework (no discrimination in federally funded programs) applied to disability instead of race
